message.content: {"caption":"A screenshot of a monospaced tool transcript showing a Django PostgreSQL dbshell test run and the reported results.","description":"A cropped screenshot of black monospaced text on a white background, enclosed by a thin light-gray border. It begins with a note about running the tests and shows the command `./tests/runtests.py --verbosity 2 --settings=test_sqlite --parallel 1 dbshell.test_postgresql`, followed by a tool input invoking that command from `/testbed`. The output says Django is installed in `/testbed/django`, imports the `dbshell` application, skips the unused `default` and `other` databases, and reports no system-check issues. Six tests are listed as passing (`ok`): `test_accent`, `test_basic`, `test_column`, `test_escape_characters`, `test_nopass`, and `test_sigint_handler`; the output notes that SIGINT is passed to psql to abort queries. It reports 6 tests run in 0.001 seconds, with zero failures, and an `OK` result. A tool response then explains the tests: accented credentials, standard connection parameters, colons in credentials, backslashes in credentials, connecting without a password, and signal handling for query abortion. Each is marked `PASS`. A numbered summary says the implementation handles special characters and passwords, manages environment variables, handles signals, works with or without passwords, and preserves functionality. The last visible line begins that the tests pass with high speed and is cut off by the bottom edge. Pale gray hooked-arrow continuation marks appear in the left margin beside many wrapped lines; there are no plotted graphics or chart elements.","figure_type":"screenshot","chart_values":[]}
